dataset: Frozen evidence60, all 60 questions; no replacement or silent deletion
group_definition: One contiguous activity episode: the same ongoing interaction, demonstration or goal-directed procedure. Substeps on the same object in a continuous procedure stay ONE group even when scoring asks their order. Different shot angles, brief narration, pauses and fixed-window splits do not split the episode. Distant distinct occurrences or clearly separate independently introduced subject sections are separate. Do not equate every action or scoring fact with an episode.
boundary_definition: Evidence-bearing core interval, not a claim of exact cinematic event onset/offset. Recoverable source subtitle boundaries and actual frame PTS anchor the interval. Separate padded review intervals retain context. Sparse visual boundaries retain uncertainty.
inputs: Frozen question/rubric, prior cited source anchors, full ORIGINAL subtitle timeline, original sampled frames. No generated captions.
stages: deterministic boundary snapping, overlap repair and source projection
API boundary/support audit with original frames and subtitles
revision when substantive issue is found
raw-source sufficient-subset test and leave-one-group-out checks
Codex review of per-question audit, source anchors and unresolved cases
export all 60 with integrity checks and statistics

normalization.nearby_merge: Model must justify separating nearby intervals; no gap threshold substitutes for event continuity.

projection.frames_for_text_only_groups: Boundary context sampled for visual review; support can remain subtitle-only
projection.text_only_groups: Sample start, midpoint and end for scene context; original full subtitle spans determine text support. Visual-anchor groups receive six flank/boundary samples plus three interior samples.

audit.subset_tests: Evaluator sees only retained groups source, question and rubric; no excluded group descriptions, timestamps, old answer, prior decisions or proposed coverage. Report irreducibility relative to this source collection, not global-video minimum.

reproducibility: Frozen IDs, input hashes, source member hashes, exact prompts, per-call input/output cache and code snapshots. Replaying cached outputs is exact; a fresh stochastic API run may differ.
limitations: No exhaustive full-video search or human gold. A later support or scope failure is recorded against the frozen question, never repaired by silently rewriting the question or dropping it. Evidence-group count is distinct from minimum required groups.
change_note: Pilot oversegmented a continuous rabbit-craft procedure into action steps. Tighten activity-level continuity; preserve complete v1.0 pilot artifacts at parent root and run v1.1 separately. Permit subtitle transition overlap within a small boundary-uncertainty band rather than oscillating around an incomplete sentence.
